cardiovascular.name: Cardiovascular
cardiovascular.function: Pumps blood and carries oxygen to the whole body.
cardiovascular.space_effects: Fluid shift towards the head and cardiac deconditioning.

musculoskeletal.name: Musculoskeletal
musculoskeletal.function: Bones and muscles: support and movement.
musculoskeletal.space_effects: Without gravity, 1–1.5% of bone density is lost each month, along with muscle mass.

immune.name: Immune
immune.space_effects: Stress and confinement alter the immune response.

metabolic.name: Metabolism and nutrition
metabolic.space_effects: A limited diet and hormonal changes affect metabolism.

neuro_behavioral.name: Neurobehavioral
neuro_behavioral.function: Mood, sleep, cognition and relationships with the crew.
neuro_behavioral.space_effects: Isolation, confinement and disrupted sleep affect mood.

eyes.name: Eyes (SANS)
eyes.space_effects: Fluid pressure towards the head can deform the eyeball (SANS).

radiation.name: Radiation (whole body)
radiation.space_effects: Outside Earth's magnetosphere the dose rises sharply.
